rename_migration: Renaming a lens heading is a migration, not a regression: update that entry's `anchor` here in the same commit as the rename.

roster_snapshot.source: private memory store index, section "Method - how to be right"
roster_snapshot.note: The store lives outside this repository and is absent from every CI runner. `count` is the pinned anchor a standing check can hold; reconciling the roster against the live store is a dated one-time observation recorded at delivery, not a regression guard.

specificity_floor.note: Two independently-checked components. A trigger that is present to a text search and absent to a reader fails one of them.

lens_body_floor.note: A lens whose body is a pointer ("see the promotion manifest") satisfies a naive reachability read while moving the lesson nowhere a session reads. A trigger assertion cannot see it, because the trigger sentence survives inside the gutted section. Measures substance, not quality: 300 characters of prose passes whether or not it carries the core - what it cannot be is a pointer. Shortest lens shipped here is 468 characters.
